hardware: Apple M5, ANGLE Metal Renderer, Darwin 25.6, local Chromium preview
method: Visible-page requestAnimationFrame, manually rendering paused scene through actual WebGLRenderer. P50/P95 use sorted sample ranks. Resource estimates inspect all scene references including hidden fallback objects.
limitations: Different sample counts; small timing changes do not establish a speedup
CPU submission is not GPU duration
V3 has higher draw calls and triangle count
RGBA8 texture estimate includes generated mipmaps, can duplicate shared references and excludes HDR precision, render targets and driver allocations
Geometry estimate can count shared backing storage more than once
No sustained traversal, thermal, battery, internet bandwidth or real phone benchmark
